name: Leonardo AW109
summary: Fast, sleek light twin used in the US for air ambulance, corporate and police work.

engines: Two engines side by side behind the mast with two exhausts
fuselage: Slim, streamlined fuselage with a long pointed nose
tail: Vertical fin with a ventral fin below the boom
Small horizontal stabilizer on the boom

tellTales: Slim, pointed-nose light twin on retractable wheels
Four blades with a two-blade open tail rotor
Low, sleek profile with no sponsons

confusedWith.howToTell: The AW109 is smaller with four blades and no sponsons; the AW139 has five blades and gear sponsons.
The AW119 has a single engine and fixed skids; the AW109 has two engines and usually retractable wheels.
The S-76 is larger with a four-blade tail rotor; the AW109 has a two-blade tail rotor.
The Bell 222 has a two-blade rotor and stub-wing sponsons; the AW109 has a four-blade rotor and retractable gear in a more compact body.
The AW169 has a five-blade rotor and is larger; the AW109 has four blades and a smaller body.
